metadata.source: Copy of the 2017 MC51 preset, with the most powerful published 2020 figures: Gaadiwaadi (41.7 PS), Japanese listing (2.5 kgf·m torque), Indian site (25 N·m). Valve timing, lift, valve sizes, runner, ECU binary and drivetrain are still the 2017 values.
metadata.notes: 2020 model. Bore 62.3 mm, stroke 41.4 mm, compression 12.1:1, displacement 249.7 cc (moto-data and the Japanese magazine). Published power: 41.7 PS (Gaadiwaadi), 41 PS @ 13,000 rpm (Japanese listing), 40.2 bhp @ 13,000 rpm (Indian site); moto-data lists 36.3 hp. Published torque: 25 N·m @ 11,000 rpm (Indian site), 2.5 kgf·m @ 11,000 rpm (Japanese listing); moto-data lists 23.3 N·m @ 10,500 rpm. Bore × stroke gives about 252 cc, not 249.7 cc, so one of these figures is off. Compression 11.5 vs 12.1 is disputed; the higher value is used. Valve sizes (24.5 / 21.0 mm), valve timing, runner, ECU binary and drivetrain are still the 2017 values and are not verified for 2020.
